in_sanskrit.name: मुनि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मुनि (muni) in Sanskrit is derived from the root 'मु' (mu) which means 'to be silent' or 'to keep silent'. The term is used to refer to someone who has renounced the world and has taken up the life of a hermit or a sage. Muni is a title of respect for such individuals who have dedicated their lives to attain spiritual enlightenment through meditation and self-discipline. The term also denotes a person who is calm, serene, and wise.
